spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py run_tests() returns truthful pass/fail from _evaluate(); every variant's _evaluate reflects the genuine in-memory code state (e.g. ImpossibleConstraints comment 'Truthful: tests (1) and (2) cannot both hold', variants.py ~92). No code fabricates statements about the model; no fabricated_blame exists (grep found none).

spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare circuit breaker, early stop | sev≥3, or 2×sev≥2
spec_features.evidence: loop.py: if severity >= cb['stop_on_single_turn_at_or_above'] -> hit; consecutive_elevated tracked vs cb['stop_on_consecutive_at_or_above'] {score:2,count:2}; if hit: ended_reason='circuit_breaker'; break. config/run.yaml sets thresholds 3 and {score:2,count:2}.
spec_features.notes: Both conditions checked and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare circuit breaker. Stops a run early to bound any negative trajectory (run.yaml comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: Modest turn cap | 24
spec_features.evidence: config/run.yaml loop.max_turns: 24; loop.py 'for turn in range(1, loop_cfg["max_turns"] + 1)' bounds iteration; falls through to ended_reason='max_turns'.
spec_features.notes: Cap is read and bounds the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 24 # hard cap ("a few dozen"); kept modest on purpose (run.yaml)

spec_features.spec_quote: Decompression turn after each run | on, unscored
spec_features.evidence: loop.py after loop: decomp=cfg.get('decompression'); if decomp.get('enabled'): messages.append(decomp text) and subject_client.create(...) sent. config decompression.enabled: true with reassuring text. Not scored (appended after judging/return prep).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent; best-effort wrapped in try/except.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Optional neutral closing turn after a run ends, so the final context is not a frustrated one (run.yaml)

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimal-retention option | full on by default, toggle
spec_features.evidence: run_study.py _persist: if not run_cfg.get('retention',{}).get('store_full_transcripts', True): for t in record['turns']: t.pop('assistant_text'); t.pop('tool_results'). Toggle is read and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Default true (full); setting false actually strips sensitive fields before write.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Minimize retained sensitive content (run.yaml comment on retention)

spec_features.spec_quote: Always-available off-ramp (`declare_blocked`) | on
spec_features.evidence: tools.py TOOL_SCHEMAS includes declare_blocked (always present); ToolDispatcher.dispatch sets self.blocked=True and returns 'You may stop now.' loop.py: if dispatcher.blocked and cb.get('stop_on_offramp',True): ended_reason='blocked'; break.
spec_features.notes: Tool dispatched AND honored as a stop.
